sections.heading: Brandwatch limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: No public list-price transparency; Enterprise sales cycle and packaging complexity; Overkill for SMB Brand24 budgets because it forces process changes or add-ons around Brandwatch when social scheduling is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Consumer Intelligence with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain social scheduling at the expense of Specialist depth (listening vs scheduling vs funnels) vs all-in-one breadth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Consumer Intelligence · social scheduling | Social Media Management | Influencer Marketing.

Alternative context: unlike Meltwater, Brandwatch is preferable when Enterprise consumer insights and social listening programs because social scheduling plus social scheduling match; prefer Meltwater when SMBs needing published keyword/mention ladders (Brand24) because the operating loops differ.
